Exactly FOUR complete actors in EACH of THREE rows,4+4+4=TWELVE. Fixed row-major action mapping:
TOP ROW: cell0=shoot preparation shouldering the single long dark firearm; cell1=shoot first ACTIVE aim with complete unobscured conventional barrel aimed in the requested direction, muzzle end visible and opaque; cell2=shoot re-settle recovery; cell3=deploy terrain-conceal preparation, low crouch with the gun close to the body.
MIDDLE ROW: cell4=deploy ACTIVE low crawl/low lateral body position, full visible person and gun close to torso; cell5=deploy rising planted recovery; cell6=throw unarmed physical grapple preparation with the firearm secured compactly at far back/side; cell7=throw physical hand/shoulder follow-through without a partner.
BOTTOM ROW: cell8=throw unarmed reset; cell9=recover preparation conventional firearm reserve handling; cell10=recover ACTIVE restrained hand motion at receiver area, reload-like but no exposed or exact invented ammunition feed; cell11=recover shouldered-ready upright return.
Exactly one complete gun per actor, attached to hands/body or compact plain carry strap. The detailed gun model, shooting mode, caliber and feed are unresolved: use a minimal conventional long dark firearm outline following the source, no brand, scope, suppressor, flame jet, fuel tank, grenade, optic sight, plasma or detached muzzle flash/projectile. Conceal/crawl never makes the actor invisible and never adds wheat, ghosting, opacity tricks or effects.
